'''Rohu Silgo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who worked on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]] while it was a part of the Republic fleet during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Working in the Cartel Bazaar section of the station, Silgo was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] of the [[Bounty Supply Company]]. The Selkath spoke in his species' [[Selkath (language)|language]], wore a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], white pants and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] while working. He had blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], no hair and [[Color/Legends|grey]] skin.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rohu Silgo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]]. In the game he serves as a Republic Bounty supply, accepting Cartel certificates as currency as well as [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. He was later removed in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].
